verdict.rationale: Amplitude's session-replay docs explicitly claim you can 'go from a chart, funnel, or support ticket to the exact session' (docs-31). They also say replay 'tie[s] errors to UX', catches errors across sessions (docs-21, docs-32), and focuses replays on specific users and flows (docs-43). This covers both the funnel drop-off and error-event entry points of the story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the drop-off-to-replay workflow (e.g., filtering replays to the users who dropped at a specific funnel step), an explicit error-event-to-replay jump, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
